locus: §1 Introduction — “The question we came with gets its answer”
current: The question we came with gets its answer: at least 9.0% of words in current legislative speech are machine-drafted — a floor, because directed effort evades the detector — with a fourfold spread across chambers, a concentration in scripted genres, and no quality penalty: against a deliberation rubric, flagged speech is better-formed and no less engaged, in the cross-chamber arm and in controlled model continuations alike.
proposed: The question we came with gets its answer: at least 9.0% of words in current legislative speech are machine-drafted. This is a floor because directed effort evades the detector. Prevalence varies fourfold across chambers and concentrates in scripted genres. It carries no quality penalty: against a deliberation rubric, flagged speech is better-formed and no less engaged, both in the cross-chamber arm and in controlled model continuations.
rationale: The original makes four principal results subordinate to one colon-heavy sentence. Short declarative sentences give each result appropriate weight without changing any finding.
